description: This Java source file defines a utility class `TransactionUtil` that provides methods for managing transactions, including beginning, committing, rolling back, suspending/resuming transactions, and handling transaction-related contexts such as timestamps and suspension stacks. It acts as a wrapper around Java EE transaction APIs to simplify transaction management within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: TransactionUtil
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for transaction management, including starting, committing, rolling back, suspending, resuming transactions, and managing transaction context data such as timestamps and stack traces.

classes.name: TransactionUtil.NoTransaction
classes.description: A nested static class implementing `Callable<V>` that executes code outside of a transaction, suspending any current transaction and resuming it afterward.

classes.name: TransactionUtil.InTransaction
classes.description: A nested static class implementing `Callable<V>` that executes code within a transaction, handling begin, commit, or rollback based on execution success.

classes.name: TransactionUtil.StampClearSync
classes.description: A private static class implementing `Synchronization` that clears transaction start stamps after transaction completion.

classes.name: TransactionUtil.RollbackOnlyCause
classes.description: A private static class encapsulating the cause message and throwable for a transaction marked for rollback, with methods for logging.

methods.name: doNewTransaction
methods.description: Runs the given Callable within a new transaction, returning the result or throwing an exception.

methods.name: doTransaction
methods.description: Runs the given Callable within an existing transaction context.

methods.name: noTransaction
methods.description: Wraps a Callable to run outside of any transaction (suspends any current transaction).

methods.name: inTransaction
methods.description: Wraps a Callable to run inside a transaction with specified timeout and exception printing options.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Starts a new transaction if none is active, respecting current transaction status; returns true if a new transaction was started.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Commits the current transaction if it is active.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction or sets it to rollback-only.

methods.name: suspend
methods.description: Suspends the current transaction, returning a Transaction object that can be resumed later.

methods.name: setTransactionTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout for the current thread's transaction.

methods.name: enlistConnection
methods.description: Enlists an XAConnection in the current transaction if present, returning a JDBC Connection.

methods.name: registerSynchronization
methods.description: Registers a Synchronization callback to the current transaction.

methods.name: getTransactionStateString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the transaction status code.

methods.name: getTransactionStartStamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of when the current transaction began, registering a Synchronization to clear stamps after completion.

methods.name: getTransactionUniqueNowStamp
methods.description: Returns a monotonically increasing timestamp, ensuring uniqueness within the same millisecond.
